newsitem.title: USA: Apt Investment sells new shrs to CEO.
newsitem.headline: Apt Investment sells new shrs to CEO.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Friday, after the market closed, that it has agreed to sell one million newly issued shares of Class A Common Stock to Terry Considine, chairman and chief executive officer, Peter Kompaniez, president, and other members of senior management.
The purchase price is $30.00 a share, AIMCO's closing price on Thursday.
Upon completion of this transaction, officers and directors will own about 12.7 percent of AIMCO's outstanding common stock and OP Units.
In payment for the stock, the company will execute notes payable to AIMCO, bearing interest at 7.25 percent per annum, payable quarterly, and due in ten years.
